mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ref_data(ref_type, parent_id, sort_order, status, field_data) VALUES (#{refType}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{fieldData})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ref_data WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ref_data WHERE ref_type = #{refType} AND status = 1 AND JSON_EXTRACT(field_data, '$.purchasable') = true ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ref_data WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
WITH RECURSIVE ancestor_chain AS ( SELECT * FROM ref_data WHERE id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT t.* FROM ref_data t INNER JOIN ancestor_chain a ON t.id = a.parent_id ) SELECT * FROM ancestor_chain
